title: Auto Loans: Enrolling a Loan in Autopay
content:
Borrowers can have the monthly installment on an Auto Loans account drawn automatically from a PCB checking account of their choosing. This page covers what an enrollment is, the rate written with it, and the customer-run action that records it.

## Scope

The policy governs a borrower's enrollment of one of their auto loans in autopay from one of their own PCB checking accounts. The APR written with the enrollment is rebuilt from its components at the time of enrollment rather than carried forward unexamined.

## What an enrollment is

Enrollment switches autopay on for a loan and names the one checking account from which each installment will be drawn. Its object is a loan whose autopay is off. A loan never has two enrollments standing side by side, and recording an enrollment neither ends nor takes the place of an enrollment that already stands on the loan.

## Result on the loan

After the call the loan reads as enrolled, with the chosen checking account set as the payer. Its rate and discount list become those passed in the call, and the bank files a completed autopay change request that evidences the borrower's instruction. Nothing is collected at the time of enrollment.

## Invoking the action

The action is `enroll_autopay_b9bffdb4`. Because enrolling is the borrower's instruction about their own money, the agent unlocks this tool and passes it to the borrower; the customer themselves carries out the call.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | the loan to be enrolled, as listed in the borrower's auto loan lookup | identifier |
| `autopay_source_account_id` | the PCB checking account that installments will be drawn from, as listed in the checking account lookup | identifier |
| `interest_rate` | the APR that applies with the enrollment | percent to two decimals, for example 6.99 for 6.99 percent |
| `rate_discounts` | which discounts the APR includes with the enrollment | one enum value from the list below |

Accepted values of `rate_discounts`: `none` means the APR includes no discount; `autopay` means it includes the autopay discount alone; `relationship` means it includes the checking relationship discount alone; `autopay_and_relationship` means it includes both.

## Receipt

The call has worked when the receipt reads status "autopay_enrolled". It also carries `request_id` for the new change request, `auto_loan_id`, `autopay_source_account_id` for the payer account, `autopay_enrolled` set to true, and the `interest_rate` and `rate_discounts` as they were stored.
